briefings.title: Full speech: VP Vance speaks at Iowa manufacturing facility
briefings.tldr: Vice President JD Vance’s address in Iowa frames the upcoming election as a choice between a government that prioritizes foreign interests and "fraudsters" versus one that protects American workers through tariffs, domestic tax cuts, and aggressive oversight of federal spending.

briefings.title: WATCH: VP Vance gives remarks in Des Moines, IA
briefings.tldr: Vice President JD Vance advocated for the re-election of Congressman Zach Nunn, framing the 2026 election as a fundamental choice between a government that prioritizes American workers through manufacturing protection and anti-fraud measures versus a Democrat party he characterizes as prioritizing illegal immigration and corporate corruption.

briefings.title: WATCH: Vice President JD Vance delivers remarks at Iowa campaign event
briefings.tldr: Vice President JD Vance framed the upcoming 2026 elections as a fundamental choice between a government that prioritizes American citizens and workers through "common sense" economic protectionism and anti-fraud measures, or one that favors special interests and illegal immigrants.
